worldcombat.skill.hiddenpower.summary: Gathers the type hidden in the user's body into a sphere and fires it; the type is decided by the user's individual values.
worldcombat.skill.hiddenpower.descriptio: Gathers the user's inherent type into a sphere fired at the target: %1$s special damage; %2$s s to gather, sphere travels at %3$s blocks/tick, range %4$s blocks.
